task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, travel east. With that done, ensure that the gateway is open. After that, go to the east. And then, pick-up the fondue from the floor of the office. Got that? Good!
description:
Well, here we are in the playroom.

You can see a shelf. The shelf appears to be empty. Silly shelf, silly, empty, good for nothing shelf. You can make out a bookshelf! The bookshelf is standard. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is an unguarded exit to the east.

thought: I should travel east as instructed.
feedback:
